summary: WebRender received broad improvements to rendering accuracy and CSS support, including CSS `corner-shape` with superellipse corners, more reliable gradients and box shadows, and better handling of borders, clipping, text, transforms, and device-pixel snapping. The work also improves picture-cache and GPU-buffer efficiency while tightening shader, test, profiler, and shutdown behavior. **Users should see crisper edges, more consistent text and shapes, and fewer rendering glitches**, especially at unusual zoom levels, transforms, or display scales.
